title: Net force on plate
description: Essential: Correct final expression for the net horizontal force on the right plate, including magnitude and direction (implied by sign).

title: Crust density relation
description: Essential: Correct derivation of the approximate linear density-temperature relation and identification of the constant k.

title: Crust thickness D
description: Essential: Correct expression for the far-distance crust thickness D in terms of given parameters.

title: Net horizontal crust force
description: Essential: Correct leading-order expression for the net horizontal force F on the right half of the crust.

title: Characteristic time τ
description: Essential: Correct dimensional analysis yielding the characteristic thermal equilibration time τ.

title: Hydrostatic equilibrium application
description: Important: Correct application of hydrostatic equilibrium to relate pressures at the ridge axis and far away.

title: Pressure integration setup
description: Important: Correct setup of the integral for the net horizontal force on the crust, defining pressure profiles at x=0 and x=∞.

title: Small parameter approximation
description: Important: Consistent use of the small k_l (or k) approximation, neglecting higher-order terms in derivations.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for the net force (e.g., confusing force direction or pressure difference).

title: Dimensional inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Final answer for any part has incorrect dimensions or mismatched units.
